purpose: Run a complete conversational tool assistant before training: actual document reads, computations, draft state and follow-up corrections. No published checker qualification.
headroom: Record whether parent exceeds 20/24; that would leave insufficient space for the fixed development gain. Do not respond by weakening the parent or retraining on this evaluation.
stop_rule: One exact-commit CI-green CPU allocation. Original assistant retention failure stops workflow execution. Evaluate all 24 workflow episodes without tuning. Conditional two fresh-process replays after baseline qualification. Copy evidence and retire. No training or confirmation evaluation follows automatically.
